signals.source_text: Queen Eduhauana stood before the observation aperture one final time, reviewing the Second Coming's outcomes with satisfaction that three thousand years of patience had earned.
Queen Eduhauana stood before the observation aperture one final time, reviewing the Second Coming's outcomes with satisfaction that three thousand years of patience had earned.
- Remaining tribes: fragmented, isolated, mutual trust degraded beyond near-term recovery.

Behind them, the planet turned—blue and green and beautiful, its indigenous populations now divided beyond any hope of unity, their resistance broken not through military defeat but through patient exploitation of their own capacity for mistrust.
